title: Rotorweld Helicopter Tooling expands with new addition to the team
summary: The company has appointed Carl Elliott as production and logistics coordinator.
body_markdown:
Rotorweld director Sam Henderson has announced the appointment of Carl Elliott as production and logistics coordinator.


The hire comes as Rotorweld continues a period of sustained growth, driven by strong global demand for its high-quality helicopter tooling products.


In his new role, Elliott will oversee product production, tooling assembly and testing, and assist with delivery to customers worldwide.


Elliott brings an extensive background in helicopter transmission component overhaul, along with the meticulous attention to detail Rotorweld requires to ensure customers receive the highest quality products.


Elliott joins the company at an exciting time, coinciding with the completion of Rotorweld’s brand new hangar facility.


Rotorweld Helicopter Tooling is a New Zealand based company specializing in the design, manufacture and supply of specialist maintenance tooling for helicopters and gas turbine engines.


Rotorweld’s product range can be viewed at www.rotorweld.co.nz or contact sales@rotorweld.co.nz


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Rotorweld Helicopter Tooling.*
